content:
- When sentiment is positive (≥0.33) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is negative (≤0.00) in recent days, model tends to underestimate prices; increase forecast slightly.
- Model consistently overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., 70+), overshooting by 1–3 points in next 3–5 days; apply dampening factor.
- Mean reversion bias: model often holds prices too high after 3–5 consecutive days above 70; adjust downward by 0.5–1.5 points if recent 5-day avg > 70.
- Forecast horizon 30d: model tends to underestimate late-period (last 10–15 days) prices; add 0.5–1.0 point bias to final 10–15 days if sentiment is neutral or positive.
- If sentiment history shows 3+ consecutive 0.00 values, model underperforms; add 0.5–1.0 point upward bias to forecast.
